title: Sunil Vayassu 20
overview: Sunil is a drug addict. He kidnaps a five-year-old girl Neela who belongs to a middle class family. What happens next is an unusual twist that turns this thriller into a heart-warming tale. Sunil ends up becoming friends with the little girl who starts addressing him as uncle. This new bond ignites a feeling of guilt within him, thus making him rethink his decision of keeping her as a hostage.
